description: Offre de transport du réseau Tango de Nîmes Métropole (GTFS/GTFS-RT) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Tango. List of stops, schedules and routes of the Tango network circulating on the territory of Nîmes Métropole in GTFS format. Updated vehicle position, travel times and alerts in GTFS-RT format. Transportation on Demand (TAD) and TEMPO are not included. Coverage: Tango. The portal shows the English title as "Transport offer of the Tango network of Nîmes Métropole (GTFS/GTFS-RT)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Tango. Its keywords include gtfs, bus, gtfs-rt, temps-reel, horaires, metropole. The listing shows 4 download or service links in GTFS-RT, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-06-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
